wholePhysicalScope: The measured 1906 ground plan establishes the verandah setbacks, rounded side bays, entrance centreline and service wing. It is located on the historic lot at 1 Conduit Road.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the asymmetric wings, double verandahs, curved stairs and western cupola.
limitations: Models the mansion exterior with the immediate stair and verandah. The larger grounds, distant servant outbuildings, collection and surviving gatekeeper’s lodge are outside the asset.
Geographic registration and rotation are approximate within the documented lot. Historical terrace heights, colors, rear elevation openings and hidden roof slopes are estimated.
